presets.name: Portable structural smoke
presets.description: Two canonical strategies on the packaged synthetic antenna baseline with a small one-seed budget.
requirements: Installed yadof and yadof-benchmark wheels; no external simulator executable.

presets.name: Complete measured matrix
presets.description: Three packaged baselines by two canonical strategies by three fixed seeds.
requirements: YADOF_PYCHRONO_PYTHON must name an executable Python runtime with PyChrono.
YADOF_NGSPICE_EXE must name an executable ngspice binary.
This is a long-running measured campaign; run check and the derived smoke profile first.
